title: Evaluation of the target acyclic-resolution comparison
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], module injective resolution I of F and abelian injective resolution R of its underlying sheaf [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and an augmentation-compatible cochain map phi from the forgotten I to R, homology of sections of phi sends abelianResolutionIso(X,I)(z) [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization] to abelianInjectiveResolutionIso(X,F,R)(z), for every degree p and z in H(F,p) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison].

proof.text: Apply canonical acyclic-resolution comparison naturality to the augmentation square with the identity coefficient map. Cancel the target inverse isomorphism. Compose with the identical terminal-source Ext and site-sections comparisons on both sides, then evaluate on z. Forgotten module injectives are section-acyclic by 03FD.
Rewrite the computational injective constructor by its proved equality with the original acyclic constructor. The existing naturality and cancellation proof then applies unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Existing acyclic comparison evaluation, moved below the leaf and adapted using equality of the constructors.

from.place: Target-resolution comparison step of the abelian counit resolution calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem abelian_resolution_comparison_evaluation (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F))
    (φ : ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ R.cocomplex)
    (hφ : (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℕ)).map I.ι ≫ φ = R.ι)
    (p : ℕ) (z : H F p) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
      (((abelianSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map φ))
      ((abelianResolutionIso X I p).hom z) =
    (abelianInjectiveResolutionIso X F R p).hom z
